location: Chinthurst Hill Car Park, Wonersh, Guildford GU5 0PS
description:
On On: The Queen Victoria, Station Row, Shalford, Guildford GU4 8BY

From M25 Junction 10, take A3 south towards Guildford. Take the exit towards Guildford/A322/Horsham/A281/Bagshot. Use the left 2 lanes to turn left onto Woking Rd/A320; go through 2 roundabouts then turn right onto York Rd/A246. At the roundabout, take the 1st exit onto Onslow St/A322, slight left onto Millbrook/A281. Continue to follow A281. At the roundabout, take the 1st exit onto Kings Rd/A248, continue to follow A248. After about 1 mile, continue straight onto Wonersh Common road/B2128, car park will be signposted on right.

location: Park Hovel Holmbush Farm, Horsham RH12 4SE
description:
On On: The Black Swan, Old Brighton Road, Pease Pottage, Crawley, West Sussex, RH11 9AJ

Buchan Country Park is 2 miles from the end of the M23 just south of Gatwick. At Junction 11, Pease Pottage, turn right onto the A264, (sp Horsham & Broadfield) then LEFT at the second roundabout and left again after less than a mile. Apparently, there’s a light industrial area where you can park. I’ll believe it when I see it.

location: The Carpenters Arms, 12 Tally Rd, Limpsfield Chart, Oxted RH8 0TG
description:
On On: As above

At junction 6 of M25, take the A22 exit to Eastbourne / Godstone / Caterham / A25 / Westerham and head south on the A22. After 0.9 miles, at roundabout, take the 1st exit onto Oxted Rd / A25. At next roundabout, after0.9 miles, take the 2nd exit onto Godstone Rd / A25. Continue to follow A25 for a further 2.4 miles, then turn right onto Kent Hatch Rd / B269. After a mile turn left onto Tally Road. Pub will be on the left. Park on surrounding roads, rather than pub car park. Note: Essential to book if planning to eat.

On On: The Goat in the Garden, 21 Church Avenue, GU14 7AT

From M3 junction 4 take the A331 Blackwater Valley Road for 1.4 miles and leave at the Coleford Bridge Road (sp Mytchett & Farnborough Park) for 1 mile to Mytchett. Just over the bridge turn left for Basingstoke Canal Visitor Centre. Drive through to camping field and park there. (If coming from the south leave the BWR at the North Camp junction – also sp Ash Vale.)Then a welcome return to The Goat (W3W ///fired.trades.tunes).Turn right out of Canal Centre and straight across roundabout into Coleford Bridge Road. Follow this to the end and over the A331.Turn left at T junction into Rectory Road. At next roundabout turn right.At next roundablout turn left into Salisbury Road which becomes Church Avenue. Follow this until you see the HASH sign and Goat in the Garden on right (see Facebook).

location: Ockham Pond Road car park, Old Lane, KT11 1NR
description:
On On: The Black Swan, Old Lane, Ockham, KT11 1NG

From whichever direction you come, get onto the roundabout for the junction of the A3 and Junction 10 of M25, then take A3 south exit towards Guildford, keep in left hand lane and take first exit on to Old Lane, signposted Effingham / Hatchford / Semaphore Tower, carpark is the second one on the left after 0.2 miles, i.e. not the one with the café.

location: Abinger Hammer Village Hall, Dorking RH5 6QX
description:
On On: Abinger Hammer Village Hall

This is the annual AGM Run with food and entertainment in the Hall afterwards for a nominal charge of £5 (£10 non-members).Abinger Hammer is about halfway between Dorking and Newlands Corner on the A25. At the Tea Rooms turn south onto Felday Road (B2126) and pass the entrance to the sports ground (120 yards). The village hall is a further 120 yards on the right up a small STEEP lane (also signposted Montessori).PARKING: Go through the gate to the hall and the gate to the left and park tightly at the rear.

location: Boundary on the Green, Guards Ave, Caterham, CR3 5XL
description:
On On: The Boundary on the Green

At junction 6 of M25, take the A22 exit to Eastbourne / Godstone / Caterham / A25 / Westerham and head north on the A22, Godstone Hill, towards Caterham. After 1.2 miles, turn slight left onto Godstone Road. After 0.6 miles at the roundabout, turn left onto Station Ave/B2030, then turn right towards Church Hill/B2030, followed by taking turn left onto Church Hill/B2030. After 0.8 miles the B2030 turns left and becomes Chaldon Rd/B2031. Take slight right onto Westway. After 0.3 miles, at the roundabout, take the 3rd exit onto Coulsdon Road. 0.3 miles later turn left onto Guards Avenue, pub is on the right. Park on streets close to pub or use Tesco car park which has 3 hours free parking.

On On: The Happy Man, 12 Harvest Road, TW20 0QS

From M25 Jn13 take the A30 Egham Bypass for 1.6 miles and at the crossroads/traffic lights just after Royal Holloway turn right into St Jude’s Road (A328) – sp Englefield Green. At the roundabout after 0.1 mile turn sharp left into Bagshot Road, then first right into Corby Drive. Larksfield is on the left after another 0.1 mile. Park near this junction where space permits.The pub is a traditional boozer with space outside at the back. It will probably be necessary to park on the street some distance away (Victoria St. and nearby roads) and walk the last few yards. Food is available.

On On: The Drummond at Albury, GU5 9AG

South from Shere on Sandy Lane/Hound House Road. After 2.8 miles turn right into Barhatch Lane (it’s unmarked but it’s the next right turn 0.6 miles after Bentley Copse). After 0.3 mile turn right into Winterfold Heath Road. The car park is 300 yards on the left, look out for a SH3 sign. (Hurtwood car park 12 Reynards Hill).Note: Pub location updated 13 May

On On: The Cricketers (use garden), GU21 4XB

From M25 Jn11 take St Peter’s Way west and bear left at roundabout to Ottershaw. Atthe Paragon roundabout (6 ways – why not hexagon?) take second exit A320 and after 2.2 miles at anoter mega roundabout take 5th exit (Shores Road) sp Horsell/Chobham A245. Turn right at Bolshie’s car knocking roundabout, then left into Littlewick Road. At next roundabout, second exit is Kestrel Way. Find space after 200 yards and avoid yellow lines.Pub is a 350 yard walk, or a longer drive around.

location: Sheepleas, St. Mary’s car park, West Horsley, KT24 6TA
description:
On On: Barley Mow, 181 The Street, West Horsley, KT24 6HR

From Guildford direction: take A25 / A246 towards Leatherhead, after going straight across the Bell and Colvill roundabout and past Squires Garden Centre (on left) look out for St Mary’s Church and turn right at the church, follow road past the church car parks to the public car park at the end.From Leatherhead: follow A246 towards the Horsleys, after leaving East Horsley, shortly after passing white sign for West Horsley, turn left at St Mary’s Church and follow road past the church car parks to the public car park at the end.From the car park to the Barley Mow: turn left from the church on to the A246, turn right at the Bell and Colvill roundabout on to The Street, pub is on the left after about 0.8 miles.

On On: The Crown, RH5 5JY (food available)

From the hares: From Cock RB at Dorking go South on A24. At next RB continue on A24. On reaching A24/A29 RB take second minor road signposted Capel. Continue into centre of Village (The Street), passing ON ON Pub on right. Continue a further quarter of a mile and then park along left side of road adjacent to green area/pond. Further parking slightly further up the road on same side, or park a la Petal style. Alternatively, travel 1.8 miles further south on the A24 and turn left into Coles Lane and left at the end into The Street. Pond will be on the right.

On On: Percy Arms, Dorking Road GU4 8NP

A25 west from Dorking past Shere then turn left onto A248 towards Albury. On On to Chilworth. Just before the Percy Arms by the railway station, left into Stapleoak Lane. Over the level crossing and up to the cross roads. Left into Blackheath Lane and continue to the car park at the end.Post code may get you somewhere near.W3W: rafters.voice.decanterOn On: Percy Arms

location: Staple Hill car park, Chobham, KT16 0ED
description:
On On: The Surrey Cricketers, Windlesham, GU20 6HE

From M3 Junction 3 (Bagshot/Lightwater): Go to A322, then follow A319 to Chobham, left at roundabout, follow B383, Windsor Road for just over a mile and turn right into Staple Hill. Turn left into car park after 0.8 mile.From M25 Junction 11: Follow A320 and B386, Longcross Road to wards Chobham. After 5 miles bear left into Staple Hill and the car park will be on the right after 0.3 mile.

location: St Martins Walk car park, Mill Lane, Dorking RH4 1DX
description:
On On: The White Horse Inn, High Street Dorking, RH4 1BE

From the cock roundabout on the A24 take the High Street into Dorking. Mill Lane is a narrow passage on the right after 700 yards opposite the White Horse Inn. Follow to the car park (free on Sunday).If you can’t find the pub based on the above, you need help.

location: Hawley Sailing Club, Minley Road, Blackwater, GU17 9EZ
description:
On On: as above

From M3 Jn 4a, head north on A327 for approx. 0.8 miles, past Crown & Cushion pub, and turn right into lane to Hawley Lake Sail Training Centre (keep right and pass “no unauthorised access” sign).

location: The Bell (aka The Rat), Withybed Corner, Walton on the Hill, Tadworth KT20 7UJ
description:
On On: as above

From M25 jn9, take A24 south, then Mill Way to Headley. Turn right past the cricket club and NT car parks towards Box Hill. At T-junction turn left. After 1 mile turn left into Deans Lane. At the end after 0.6 mile in Walton on the Hill turn right and immediately left at the lake in to Withybed Corner. There is some parking at the pub, but you may have topark along the (rather rough) lane.From jn8 take the A217 north for two miles, then left onto Mill Road, New Road, Mere Road then right at the lake.

location: Stony Rock car park, Hogden Lane, RH5 6SY
description:
On On: Hash Picnic – BYO

From just north of Dorking head west on Ashcombe Raod (sp Guildford) then right at T-junction onto Ranmore Road/Ranmore Common Road for 2.5 miles, past Ranmore West NT car park, and turn right into Hogden Road (very narrow). Car park is 300 yards north on the left.From Effingham (A246) head south on Beech Avenue, then left into High Barn Road and left again after 0.6 mile into Hogden Lane (or if too narrow for you, stay on High Barn Road to the end then make two left turns.)Additional info from the hares: if Stony Rock is full (unlikely), please use Ranmore West NT car park and take the short walk back to Stony Rock.BYO chairs, drinks, etc. There are benches at the site and the hares will provide tortillas, crisps and dips.If anyone has a pop-up gazebo that we could use, it would be much appreciated, so please bring it along.

location: Puttenham Common Tarn Car Park, Cuttmill Pond, Littleworth Road, GU10 1JH
description:
On On: The Hogs Back Brewery, Manor Farm, The Street, Tongham, Farnham GU10 1DE

Favoured detailed directions: Take the A31 from Guildford towards Farnham. Before reaching Farnham, exit left signposted Seale, Tongham, Runfold. At T-junction, turn left, on to Elstead Road, direction Seale. In Seale village, pass St. Laurence Church, on left, and take immediate right turn signposted Cutmill, Elstead. Continue until crossroads with Littleworth Road. Turn left here, signposted Cutmill. Tarn Car Park is a further 1 mile downhill on the left.Alternatively; Turn off A31 Hogs Back onto B3000 towards Puttenham. 1st turn right at Puttenham into The Street then left into Suffield Lane. On for 1.8 miles to crossroads. C/P on rightOn on:Tables outdoors have been reserved for 20 people for four hours, starting 1.00pm to 1.30pm, under the name of John. We can move indoors if it is raining. What’s rain?

location: NT car park, Windsor Rd, Englefield Green, Staines SL4 2JL
description:
On On: The Fox & Castle, 21 Burfield Road, SL4 2RB

M25 Jn13: head south as if rejoining M25 and keep in left lane (A30). Spiral down to Runnymede roundabout and take the third exit (slightly right) to the A308 Windsor Road. Car park is 1.4 miles on the right where there are islands in the road. Free to NT members and probably sufferers of ADHD. Otherwise £3 for 2 hours.The pub has a large garden and is dog & fox fiendly. It is just over a mile away.

On On: Celebration picnic on Downside Common, KT11 2NN

From M25 Junction 10, take A3 north towards London. Take the first Painshill exit A245 toward Woking/Walton/B365/Cobham. At the roundabout, take the 3rd exit onto Portsmouth Rd/A245. Go across the first Sainsbury’s garage roundabout, then take second exit at next roundabout on to Between Streets. After 0.3 miles, turn right onto Downside Bridge Rd (opposite Waitrose). After about 2 miles turn left onto Downside Common Rd; after about 0.3 miles the road bears right on to Bookham Road, follow Bookham Road, underneath the M25. A very small car park is at the end, so just park along the verge on the right hand side of the road on approach to the small bridge.On On: There will be a picnic to celebrate the 90th birthdays of both FRB and Solange on Downside Common. Please try to park on the roads aligning the common (not the social club). Please bring chairs / rugs, food, drinks and games. The Cricketers are happy for us to buy drinks to carry on to the green and will serve them in plastic glasses.In inclement weather we shall retire to the Cricketers.

location: The Plough, Church Road, Leigh, RH2 8NJ
description:
On On: The Plough, Leigh, RH2 8NJ

There are many ways to go depending upon where you start. Leigh is about 4 miles south east of Dorking.The hare says:A lovely traditional country pub set on a green. As such, if a nice day, it could be busy. Suggest we all bring chairs and tables so we can sit on green with food / drinks.If wanting to dine then book early as the pub is well-known for traditional English food, good portions and reasonable prices. Real ale on tap and a good wine list (the last time I was there)!

Note: The A3 is expected to be closed NORTHBOUND around Guildford, so some people may have to find alternative routes home.

On On: The Crown, Chiddingfold, GU8 4TX

A3 south to Eashing/Milford, then take A283 through Milford. Follow signs for A283 Petworth Road and stay on it for another 4 miles to Chiddingfold. Park around the Green to your left.

On On: The Jolly Farmer, Worplesdon, GU3 3RN

Travelling north from Guildford on A320 towards Woking pass Jacobswell and bear left into Burdenshott Road.After about 1/2 mile, the Jolly Farmer is on the left just after a railway bridge. There are two small public car parks to the right of the pub.Please park sensibly in the furthest right (northerly) first and double up if possible.Travelling from the north, use the map link – there are several route options!If wanting to eat pls book a table at Jolly Farmer 01483 976048

On On: The Plough, Orestan Lane, Effingham KT24 5SW

Postal address is Dorking, but it’s between Effingham and Westcott!246 Leatherhead – Guildford road. At the Effingham junction head south on Beech Avenue / Critten Lane, past St Teresa’s School to the cross roads with Ranmoor Common road (about 2 miles). At the junction, continue straight across into White Down Lane. C/p on Right after about 500 yds.Note: It is quite a small car park so park neatly (if you are not in Provence)!

location: Devil’s Punchbowl NT cp, Hindhead, GU26 6AB
description:
On On: Devil’s Punchbowl Hotel, Hindhead, GU26 6AG

Follow A3 south and take junction just after Hindhead Tunnel. At first two roundabouts, take third exit to follow A333 Portsmouth Road, past BP station on left to Hindhead Traffic Lights. Go straight over, following signs for National Trust Devil’s Punchbowl Car Park. The Devil’s Punchbowl Hotel is on the right just before the NT car park entrance.Please park in the NT CP rather than Hotel CP if possible, particularly if a NT member, but TBH they rarely check parking tickets. It’s a one minute walk!

location: Shear Barn, Barley Lane, Hastings, TN35 5DX
description:
On On: As above

Take M25 east to J5 following M26/ A21, stay in lane 3 for A21,follow A21 to Hastings, approx. 1 hour.In Hastings, after passing two mini roundabouts, at the third roundabout turn left on A2101, follow this to the sea front, turn left at traffic lights on to A259.Follow the A259 along the front, after it turns inland, opposite the Stables Theatre, turn right into Harold Road. At the top of the short hill, turn right again into Barley Lane. Continue to the top to Shear Barn Holiday Park (at the top of Barley Lane).Parking is available in front of the reception building and on the sidee of the road opposite thr Retreat Restaurant and Bar, and in the car park through the barrier (as long as we have a fob to let you in), opposite the House Bar.If some reason there is nowhere else available, Parking is also available in the car park on the right before Shear Barn (this is pay to park),Run starts from the car park in front of the House Bar.On On – At the House Bar and/or the Retreat restaurant and Bar.Sunday roast will be available from the Restaurant for about £11 which is a fantastic deal.On On On – Weather permitting – come to Eskimo and Eveready’s Garden for some French Beer and cake.

location: Lightwater Country Park, The Avenue, GU18 5RG
description:
On On: The Red Lion, 114 Guildford Road, Lightwater, GU18 5RP

Just off M3 Jn 4. South on A322 for 200m and turn right into Guildford Road. Bear left and after another 200m turn right into The Avenue (sp Lightwater Country Park & Leisure Centre). Continue for another 800m, through the height barrier and park in the lower car park near the Leisure Centre.On on is 400m further along Guildford Road from The Avenue.

location: Sheepleas, Shere Road car park, KT24 6EP
description:
On On: The King William IV, 83 The St, West Horsley, Leatherhead KT24 6BG

At the Bell & Colville roundabout on the A246 just west of East Horsley, turn south on Shere Road. Shere Road car park is on the left after 0.7 miles.On Inn: The King William IV KT24 6BG. From the car park, head north to return to the roundabout on A246. Go straight on and the pub is on the left after 0.4 miles.

location: The Woodman, Barnett Wood Road, Ashstead, KT21 2DA
description:
On On: The Woodman

From M25 J9, take A243 Leatherhead bypass towards Dorking. At second roundabout take 1st exit signposted Ashtead A24. Turn left at Brewery Inn along Woodfield Lane. Turn left along Barnett Wood Lane. Woodman is about 500 yards on the left.Please park tightly at the top end of the car park. Food available. Pub advises booking preferred 01372 274 524.

On On: Tattenham Corner Pub, Tattenham Crescent, Epsom, KT18 5NY

We’ve been there before and it is a bugger to get to as the “obvious” roads are often gated. What3Words is a rabbit hole… but it’s the best way as the postcode will most likely misdirect you. Use the button links given!From Epsom head for the racecourse on B290 Ashley Road. After a mile stay on the B290 and pass the grandstand on your right and the Derby Arms to your left. At the big roundabout take the 3rd exit and to the next roundabout after half a mile. Take the 3rd exit (no vehicles at night) and follow the ring road on the left in a clockwise direction to the car park which will be on your right (sometimes referred to as the 7th Furlong).Or if you are coming from Purley / M25 direction (that’s the north east, believe it or not!), go along Old London Road. At the roundabout (just up from Tattenham corner) there is a tea hut on your left, go straight ahead and follow the small road round to the left until you reach a large car park on your right.SH3 last visited this pub in 2008!

location: Sidney Wood car park, Dunsfold, GU6 8HU
description:
On On: The Sun Inn, The Common, GU8 4LE

From Guildford, take the A281 to Alford Crossways, whereupon you should take a sharp right turn which involves going around an elongated roundabout. Follow the Dunsfold Road for 0.4 mile and around a sharp left bend for another 0.6 mile. On the next right bend immediately after building works on left, turn left into Sidney Wood. Then keep left.

location: The Nower & Milton Heath cp, Dorking, RH4 3JU
description:
On On: The Old House at Home, 24 West Street, RH4 1BY

Leave Dorking heading west on the A25 Westcott Road.Continue for about 1 mile / 1.5 km.The car park entrance appears on the left.
